rules.cite: Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance (LAMC ch. XVI, art. 5)
rules.coverage_text: Most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance.

exemptions.description: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some nonprofit facilities, some HACLA/government properties
exemptions.quote: There are other specific exceptions to the JCO including, but not limited to, transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, owner’s roommate, cooperatives under certain circumstances, some non-profit facilities for the homeless or short-term treatment centers for substance abuse, and some properties owned by HACLA or the government.

rules.quote: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate tenancies without just cause and must provide relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
tenancy_conditions: Tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or original lease expired, whichever comes first
rules.title: LA Just Cause for Eviction
